messages:
nora: quick ask — who's bringing spare controllers and power for Friday's chill couch co-op? batteries die mid-match every time.
jamal: i can bring a 65W power bank with pass-through and a 4-port USB-C hub. saves lives.
tia: are we expecting a lot of Switch docked play? battery life on handheld is meh for 3+ hour sessions.
lucas: i've got two sets of Joy-Cons and a wired Xbox controller. also a multi-charger for AA/AAA in case someone brings older pads.
jamal: i'll label cables and bring a little bag of cable ties so we don't end up with octopus wiring.
nora: love it. can someone bring a small folding table for chargers? desk space is limited.
infra-bot: calendar: "Couch Co-op + Chargers" created by nora for Fri 7:00 PM - 11:00 PM. Location: Lounge.

tia: tiny PSA for Steam Deck folks: enable power profile -> performance when docked, otherwise turn on battery saver for handheld runs.
games-bot: poll: Which mini-event do we want? 1) Smash free-for-all 2) Speedrun sprint 3) Co-op indie night. React with :one: :two: or :three:.
jamal: :one: for chaos.
lucas: :three: for long co-op vibes.
tia: :two: i wanna try a short speedrun challenge.
nora: also, bring your own headphones please — mute lobbies and noisy streams.
jamal: quick tip if you're USB-C docking and controller isn't detected:
```
# mac/linux
lsusb | grep -i xbox || dmesg | tail -n 20
```

lucas: i'll bring a cheap powered USB hub too. saves ports.
jamal: anyone need a temporary controller before the event? i can lend one if you promise to return in the same condition. :handshake:
tia: possibly — i'll DM you, thanks.
nora: ok final list after lunch. chargers, two hubs, spare Joy-Cons, power bank, table, snacks. see you Friday. :video_game: :battery:
